newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-RUSSIA KEEPER OVCHINNIKOV JOINS BENFICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSSIA KEEPER OVCHINNIKOV JOINS BENFICA.

text.p: Sergei Ovchinnikov, Russia's imposing and extrovert national team goalkeeper, will join Benfica from Lokomotiv Moscow next month.
"It is a great loss for us but we wish him luck and success in Benfica," said Lokomotiv manager Vladimir Korotkov on Monday.
"He was everybody's favourite in the team and it is largely due to him we won the Russian cup.
"Ovchinnikov has signed a four-year contract with Benfica. It takes effect on July 31. We hope he will continue playing for the national squad."

Ovchinnikov only came to international prominence in the past year and has won five of his eight caps in the last 12 months. He has become Russia's first-choice keeper, replacing Austria-based Stanislav Cherchesov.
